title: Mehtab Singh and Sukha Singh Accept the Mission

blocks.text: The taunts and lament now harden into decision. Sukha Singh joins Mehtab Singh and the two accept that the duty of striking Massa Ranghar cannot be postponed to some safer season.

They therefore take leave of the Khalsa with full awareness that they may not return. The page treats their resolve as readiness for martyrdom, because success will require entering hostile ground where capture is almost certain if the plan fails.
Preparation follows resolve. Disguise, secrecy, and a swift approach toward Amritsar are chosen so that devotion to the shrine can be expressed through bold but disciplined action.
